title: Pakati peNyika neDenga
intro: Mweya unoshamisa wakakumirira mumapeji matsvene enhoroondo yaMwari, wakatakura zviratidzo nezvishamiso zvichiri kudzokororwa mumakore ese. Sezvaunotevera nzira yezviratidzo, uchafamba nemunyaya ine zvishamiso - kubva pakutanga kunoshamisa kusvika pakukwira kupfuura denga. Unogona kuziva muranda uyu akaropafadzwa usati waona chiratidzo chekupedzisira here?
clues: Ndakatumwa semutumwa kuvana veIsraeri nemashoko etsitsi nechiedza.
Kuberekwa kwangu kwaive chiratidzo chinoshamisa — ndakauya munyika ino ndisina baba, nemurairo weWemasimbaose.
Ndakataura ndichiri mucheche, ndichidzivirira rukudzo rwaamai vangu kubva pakupomerwa kwevanhu vavo.
Nemvumo yaAllah, ndakaumba shiri kubva muvhu ndikafemera hupenyu madziri — dzakabhururuka dzichienda pamberi peavo vaidziona.
Ndakaporesa vakazvarwa vari mapofu, ndakaporesa vane maperembudzi, uye ndakatomutsa vakafa — asi chishamiso chese chakaitwa nemvumo yaAllah, kwete yangu.
Vavengi vangu pavakaronga kundiparadza, Allah vakandisimudzira kudenga uye vakavimbisa kudzoka kwangu Zuva reKutongwa risati rasvika.

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
